scenarios.name: Correct an invalid custom annotation scale

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and activates BrowserView
an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto
the Edit Annotation Scale dialog is open
the user replaces the scale with "0"
the user replaces the scale with "1:0"
the user replaces the scale with "abc"
the user replaces the scale with "3:2"
the scale text returns to its normal color
